skirmish.module.minimap.name: Minimap
skirmish.module.minimap.description: A minimap on the HUD from the world map's tiles: round or square, north up or turning with you. On it: you, players (faces, friends in their colour, an arrow when well above or below), mobs, your waypoints (farther ones on the rim) and the compass letters. Only what your client already gets from the server; no lines or outlines. Invisible ones are off by default. HolyWorld's rule 2.4 allows minimaps with players since 14 July.
skirmish.module.minimap.setting.shape.to: Round, or square with rounded corners
skirmish.module.minimap.setting.rotate.t: The map turns with you so what is ahead is always up. Off: north up
skirmish.module.minimap.setting.zoom.too: How many blocks fit across the map; the key below cycles them
Faces of players nearby. Friends and clanmates are ringed in their colour; an arrow over or under a face means above or below you
Red dots: zombies, skeletons, creepers and the like
skirmish.module.minimap.setting.invisibl: Show invisible players and mobs. Rule 2.4 allows it (minimaps showing invisibility are allowed since 14 July), your call
skirmish.module.minimap.setting.waypoint: Your waypoints; farther ones sit on the rim in their direction
skirmish.module.minimap.setting.coords.t: An X · Y · Z pill under the map
